newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis..

text.p: (Not a General Obligation of the City)
The City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin (the City'') wil receive sealed bids up to 10:00 A.M. Central Standard Time, on Tuesday,

at the Office of the City Comptroller, Room 405, City Hall, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, for the purchase of $100,000,000 principal amount of Short-Term Promissory Notes, Series of 1997-A, dated February 25, 1997 (the

time and place such bids will be publicly opened. The Notes are not a general obligation, do not constitute an indebtedness of the City for the purpose of determining the City's constitutional debt limitation, and no tax shall be levied to pay the Notes or the interest thereon. The Notes are being issued pursuant to the provisions of Section 67.12(1), Wisconsin Statutes, for the purpose of financing the operating budget of the City on an interim basis pending receipt of State shared revenue payments due in November, 1997. The City will enter into a trust agreement with The Chase Manhattan Bank, whereby the City on or before December 31, 1997 will irrevocably deposit General Fund revenues to purchase direct obligations of the U.S. Government in an amount sufficient together with earnings thereon to pay the principal and interest due on the Notes at maturity. Pending the deposit in trust of the General Fund revenues, as security for repayment of the Notes and interest thereon, the City has pledged and will irrevocably segregate upon receipt State shared revenue payments due in November, 1997 in an amount ith interest thereon to pay the principal and interest due on the Notes at maturity and the City has irrevocably pledged all other General Fund revenues included in the budget for calendar year 1997 which are due the City and not yet paid as of the date of delivery of and payment for the Notes and which are not otherwise applied. The Notes shall be issued in registered form in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York. The Notes shall mature on February 19, 1998, bear interest payable at maturity, and be of such denominations and bear such other details as set forth in the Official Notice of Sale herein referred to. The Notes are not subject to prior redemption. The Notes will be awarded to the bidder(s) complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale. The final approving opinion of Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, bond counsel to the City, will be furnished to the
successful bidder without cost. There will also be furnished the usual closing documents, dated as of the date of
delivery of and payment for the Notes, includin
certificate that there is no litigation pending or

threatened affecting the validity of the Notes. Copies of the Near Final Official Statement and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form for the purchase of the Notes may be obtained from the City Comptroller at the above address, telephone (414) 286-2319 or (414) 286-2301. Reference should be made to the Official Notice of Sale for information related to the Note details, award, form of bid, good faith deposit and purchase price, right of rejection, security, authority, delivery and CUSIP Numbers. The City Comptroller will furnish supplemental information to any bidder upon request.
